title: Linking to a Document Hosted Elsewhere
excerpt: When a source must remain on another service, the external-document template provides context and a clear outbound action without depending on iframe permissions.
body:
## Why use an external record?

Large files, institutional archives, or source-controlled repositories may need to remain outside the publication. This template keeps the article page stable while making the hosting boundary clear to readers.
author: editorial-team
document_description: The source is maintained outside this publication. The destination opens in a new browser tab.
seo_description: A safe external-document article template that does not assume iframe support.
